quests.instruction: What item do we wear made from a sturdy blue fabric called denim?
quests.question: Jeans
quests.hint: They are usually a deep blue color!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Jeans are made from tough denim, strong enough for climbing and rough play!
quests.funFact: Jeans are made from a strong, sturdy fabric called denim!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear to dress up as a superhero, animal, or fairy tale character?
quests.question: Costume
quests.hint: You wear this to pretend to be someone else!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Costume lets you dress up and pretend to be someone or something fun!
quests.funFact: A costume can turn you into a superhero, a dragon, or anything you imagine!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that slips over our head with no sleeves or buttons?
quests.question: Poncho
quests.hint: It has a hole for your head, and that's it!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Poncho is a simple piece with a head-hole that drapes over your shoulders!
quests.funFact: A poncho is just one simple piece with a hole cut for your head!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that is thin and light, but still blocks a gusty breeze?
quests.question: Windbreaker
quests.hint: It is thin, but it still blocks the wind!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Windbreaker is thin and light, yet still blocks a gusty breeze!
quests.funFact: A windbreaker is thin, but it still keeps gusty wind off your skin!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear when we jump and splash in puddles after a storm?
quests.question: Rain Boots
quests.hint: They are made of waterproof rubber!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Rain Boots are made of waterproof rubber, keeping your feet dry in puddles!
quests.funFact: Rain boots are made of rubber, so water cannot soak through them!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that hugs our whole head snugly, with no brim at all?
quests.question: Beanie
quests.hint: It has no brim at all!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Beanie is a snug knitted hat with no brim, keeping your whole head warm!
quests.funFact: A beanie has no brim, so it hugs your whole head snugly!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear with just one strap that fits between our big toe and the next?
quests.question: Flip-Flops
quests.hint: A single strap fits between just two toes!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Flip-Flops have one simple strap and slide on fast for easy beach days!
quests.funFact: Flip-flops get their name from the flip-flap sound they make when you walk!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear over our clothes while we bake cookies or paint a picture?
quests.question: Apron
quests.hint: You wear this over your clothes while cooking or painting!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Apron ties over your clothes to protect them from spills and splashes!
quests.funFact: An apron catches spills and splatters before they reach your clothes!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that every student at the same school wears together?
quests.question: Uniform
quests.hint: Everyone on the same team or school wears the same one!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Uniform is worn by everyone on the same team or school, all matching!
quests.funFact: A uniform shows everyone which team or school you belong to!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear with a front panel and straps that go over our shoulders?
quests.question: Overalls
quests.hint: They have straps that go over your shoulders!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Overalls have shoulder straps and a front panel, so they never need a belt!
quests.funFact: Overalls have straps over the shoulders, so you never need a belt!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that covers our legs and feet all in one thin, stretchy piece?
quests.question: Tights
quests.hint: They cover your legs AND your feet, all in one!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Tights cover your legs and feet in one thin, stretchy piece for warmth!
quests.funFact: Tights cover your legs and your feet, all in one thin piece!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear over our pajamas to stay warm right after a bath?
quests.question: Bathrobe
quests.hint: You wear this right after a warm bath!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Bathrobe is thick and fluffy, worn to stay warm right after a bath!
quests.funFact: A bathrobe is thick and fluffy, perfect for right after a warm bath!

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear around our neck to keep cozy and warm?
quests.question: Scarf
quests.hint: Think about this: It can be long and dangly or short and cozy.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Scarf wraps around your neck to keep it warm and cozy!
quests.funFact: A long scarf can be wrapped around your neck more than once.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear to keep each finger warm and toasty?
quests.question: Gloves
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wear these to make a snowball without cold hands.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Gloves keep every finger warm and toasty in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Each finger of a glove has its own separate little pocket.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear on our legs to keep them warm?
quests.question: Pants
quests.hint: Think about this: They have two long tubes, one for each leg.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Pants cover both your legs to keep them warm and safe!
quests.funFact: Long ago, only certain people wore pants, but now almost everyone does.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear that is thicker and warmer than a light jacket?
quests.question: Coat
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It is your best friend on a snowy day.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Coat is thick and warm, worn over everything else in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Some coats are stuffed with soft, fluffy material to trap warm air.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear to keep our toes warm and cozy?
quests.question: Socks
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are soft and can have fun patterns.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Socks keep your feet warm and make your shoes comfortable!
quests.funFact: Some socks have five little sections, one for each toe.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear that is knitted from soft, warm yarn?
quests.question: Sweater
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Grandparents sometimes knit these by hand.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Sweater is soft and warm, perfect for chilly days indoors or out!
quests.funFact: A cozy sweater is perfect for the first chilly days of autumn.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear when we walk on warm sand near the ocean?
quests.question: Sandals
quests.hint: Here's a clue: Your toes can peek out of these!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Sandals have open straps that let your feet stay cool in the sun!
quests.funFact: Sandals let your toes feel fresh air on a hot day!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear on the very coldest days, warmer than regular gloves?
quests.question: Mittens
quests.hint: Here's a clue: Your fingers snuggle together inside, not separated!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Mittens keep your fingers snuggled together, which makes them extra warm!
quests.funFact: Mittens keep your fingers extra warm because they snuggle together!

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear that stops above our knees to keep our legs cool?
quests.question: Shorts
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wear these when it is too hot for pants.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Shorts keep your legs cool and free to move on hot days!
quests.funFact: Shorts let air flow around your legs so you feel less sweaty.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear shaped like a simple square with a hole for our head?
quests.question: Poncho
quests.hint: It has no sleeves and no buttons.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Poncho is a simple piece with a head-hole that drapes over your shoulders!
quests.funFact: A poncho can drape loosely over a backpack to keep it dry too.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear for a fun dress-up party or a school play?
quests.question: Costume
quests.hint: You might wear one for a dress-up party or a play.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Costume lets you dress up and pretend to be someone or something fun!
quests.funFact: Costumes are worn for parties, plays, and dress-up fun.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that is tough enough for climbing trees and playing outside?
quests.question: Jeans
quests.hint: They are made from a tough fabric called denim.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Jeans are made from tough denim, strong enough for climbing and rough play!
quests.funFact: Jeans were first made for gold miners who needed super tough pants.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear when it is not cold enough for a thick winter coat?
quests.question: Windbreaker
quests.hint: It makes a soft rustling sound when you move.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Windbreaker is thin and light, yet still blocks a gusty breeze!
quests.funFact: Windbreakers often rustle softly because of their smooth, light fabric.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear made of soft, stretchy, knitted material?
quests.question: Beanie
quests.hint: It is soft, stretchy, and knitted.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Beanie is a snug knitted hat with no brim, keeping your whole head warm!
quests.funFact: Beanies are knitted from soft, stretchy yarn, just like a cozy sweater.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that is made of rubber to keep every drop of water out?
quests.question: Rain Boots
quests.hint: They are perfect for jumping in puddles.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Rain Boots are made of waterproof rubber, keeping your feet dry in puddles!
quests.funFact: Jumping in a puddle is much more fun with rain boots on.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that ties around our waist and neck to catch spills?
quests.question: Apron
quests.hint: It ties around your neck and waist.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Apron ties over your clothes to protect them from spills and splashes!
quests.funFact: Chefs and painters both wear aprons to protect their outfits.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear with a soft, rounded top and no floppy edges?
quests.question: Cap
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It has a curved brim just at the front!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Cap has a curved front brim that shades your eyes from the sun!
quests.funFact: A cap has a curved brim only at the front, not all the way around!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear when we want a warm top with a hood attached?
quests.question: Hoodie
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It has a hood attached at the neck!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Hoodie has a warm hood attached that you can pull up over your head!
quests.funFact: A hoodie has its own built-in hood you can pull up any time!
